name: gitlab
description: Work on GitLab merge requests and pipelines of the current repository, picking the host and token from its git remote, or from a host you name.

tokens.title: GitLab tokens
tokens.description: host=token pairs separated by commas, one per GitLab you use (gitlab.com=glpat-..., gitlab.example.com=glpat-...). Each token is sent only to its own host: the repository's git remote, the host a tool call names, or defaultHost. Needs the api scope; when this option is not set, the SPIDER_PLUGIN_OPTION_GITLAB_TOKENS environment variable gives the same pairs; leave it out of repository settings, which would make the plugin refuse it.

defaultHost.title: Default GitLab host
defaultHost.description: The GitLab host (gitlab.example.com) the tools use when the repository's remote is not a GitLab with a token, such as a GitHub repository about work MRs. It needs a token in tokens; tools then need project (group/project or numeric id). When not set, SPIDER_PLUGIN_OPTION_GITLAB_DEFAULT_HOST gives it.
